sentences.en: The mother used her own milk to nourish the baby.
sentences.zh: 妈妈用自己的奶水养育了这个婴儿。

sentences.en: He can nourish his elephant, but cannot nourish his child.
sentences.zh: 他可以养活大象，却无法抚养自己的孩子。

sentences.en: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
sentences.zh: 胎盘的作用是滋养胎儿。

senses.zh: 养育，培养：provide with food；培养，促进：help with growth
